home.meta_title: Property operations software for vacation rentals · Pulse Flow
home.meta_description: Property management and property operations in one app: villas, jobs, maintenance, vendors, bills and guests. Built for short-term rental owners and managers.
home.og_title: The pulse of your rental operations
home.og_description: Property operations and property management in one shared app for vacation rental owners, managers, staff and guests.
home.og_image_alt: Pulse Flow: property operations software for short-term rental owners, managers, staff and guests
home.headline: The pulse of your rental operations
home.sub: Property management without the chat chaos: properties, jobs, tasks, vendors, bills and guests in one workspace. Everyone sees their own part, in their own language.
home.proof_line: We are launching on Koh Phangan, onboarding the first teams by hand. Reviews will appear here when there are real ones.
home.alt_1: You send a job. You have no idea if anyone picked it up until you call.
home.alt_2: Receipts pile up as photos in a thread. Month-end means hunting through them.
home.alt_3: Someone leaves. Their vendor contacts and arrangements leave with their phone.
home.alt_answer: The chat is not going anywhere, and it should not. Pulse Flow picks up where the chat stops working: a job that is confirmed, a cost attached to a property, and a history that stays with the company.
home.card_villas_desc: One list for the owner, the assigned manager, and the person on site. Property details, status, map pin, stay dates, and a photo, so the whole team understands the objects assigned to them.
home.card_jobs_desc: Simply add your property maintenance staff contacts and book them with a call or message. Or invite them to the app for both sides' convenience - staff will be able to accept jobs in-app.
home.card_money_desc: Watch how much maintenance costs you for a different period, filter by categories, approve bills when paid. All data is exportable for seamless integration with your budget sheets.
home.card_guests_desc: Trace all aspects of guest relations: invite regulars to book via the app at local rates, share house rules. A deposit with every deduction so no more misunderstanding.
home.lang_title: One language for the whole team
home.lang_desc: The manager writes the job in English, the cleaner reads it in Thai, the owner sees it in Hebrew. Each person sets their language once in their profile - jobs, chat, and messages arrive in their language automatically.
home.why_lead: Every role gets its own screen. Open the one that is about you.
home.audience_owner_desc: Occupancy, urgent work, and spend - without asking anyone.
home.audience_manager_desc: Build the day once. Hand the shift over with its full history.
home.audience_staff_desc: Your jobs on your phone. Confirm with one tap, send receipts from the site.

home.agent_li1: Create a connection key in Settings, paste it into agent's shell, and disconnect it anytime.
home.agent_li2: Read who you are, the team, properties with check-in and check-out, open tasks, jobs and bills.
home.agent_li3: Create a task or a job for a teammate.
home.agent_li4: Mark a task done when the work is finished.
home.agent_li5: Owners and managers only. Staff and guests do not get this. After the trial it is part of Pro.
home.agent_cta: Chat in the app, or connect under Settings → Connect your agent.
home.agent_safety: The agent never gets the database key. It only uses that personal connection, scoped to your current company workspace.

home.faq_q1: My cleaners are not going to use another app.
home.faq_a1: They do not need to learn anything new. You send them a link, they open it in their browser, and it sits on their phone like any other app. No download, no account, no App Store. They see only their jobs, in their own language, and confirm with one tap. If they can read a WhatsApp message, they can use this.
home.faq_q2: My manager already has a system. Why would they switch?
home.faq_a2: They would not be switching - they would be adding one place where the jobs they already manage become visible to everyone else. The chat stays. What changes is that a job now has a confirmed status, a cost attached to it, and a record that does not disappear when someone leaves.
home.faq_q3: Everything is on Airbnb and Booking. Does this replace them?
home.faq_a3: No. Bookings stay where they are. Pulse Flow is about what happens after the booking: who cleans, what broke, what it cost, and what the guest can see. You can paste each listing’s private calendar export (.ics) from Airbnb or Booking.com into a property to pull reserved nights into the Bookings calendar. That is not a full channel API and does not replace their listings or checkout.
home.faq_a4: Personal is free forever. Company is paid by the owner; team seats stay free. Both Personal and Company can add Pro for Connect your agent AI integration: USD 9 / month on Personal, USD 19 / month on Company. Right now billing is not live, so every account gets 3 months of full access — including Pro — from the day it signs up.

home.pain_team_2: Only one person knows which vendor to call
home.pain_team_3: Manager is out - the plan goes with them
home.pain_team_4: No shared view of what is happening today
home.pain_jobs_1: Job sent. No idea who took it
home.pain_jobs_2: Wrong villa - the chat buried the address
home.pain_jobs_3: Work done. No record of who or how much
home.pain_money_1: No clear maintenance cost per property
home.pain_money_2: Receipts lost in chats until month-end
home.pain_money_3: Out-of-pocket spend with no payback trail
home.pain_guests_1: Deposit disputes with no written record
home.pain_guests_2: House rules sent. Guest says they never got them
home.pain_guests_3: Returning guests message your personal number to book
home.alt_closing: Your rental operation, always on pulse
home.faq_q5: Will my guests have to do anything complicated?
home.faq_a5: No. You send them a link. They open it, read the house rules, and see their deposit balance. No download, no account, no payment through the app. Payments go directly to you - the app just keeps a record of the amount, any deductions, and the balance so both sides see the same thing.
home.faq_q6: Can a guest dispute a deposit deduction?
home.faq_a6: Every deduction is recorded in the app with a reason and a date. Both you and the guest see the same balance. There is no "I never received the rules" or "I don't remember agreeing to that" - it is all in one place, timestamped, and visible to both sides.
home.faq_q7: What if a guest wants to book again?
home.faq_a7: Returning guests can send a date request directly through the app. It goes to the owner or manager without going through your personal number or a third-party platform.
home.faq_q8: What happens when a staff member leaves?
home.faq_a8: Their job history, vendor contacts, and property notes stay in the system. Nothing walks out the door with their phone. The next person you bring in sees the same information from day one.
home.faq_q9: Can I use this for one property?
home.faq_a9: Yes. The personal plan is free forever and covers one or two properties you manage yourself. You get the same features - jobs, expenses, guests - without needing a team.
home.faq_a10: Each workspace is separate. Your properties, team, guests, and financials are visible only to the people you invite. Guests see only what you share with them.

terms.meta_description: Terms for Pulse Flow: a Thailand-focused ops helper for property teams and guests — not a landlord, booking site, or payment processor for stays.
terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of Pulse Flow (the "Service"), including www.pulseflow.site and app.pulseflow.site. By creating an account or using the Service, you agree to these Terms.
terms.summary_li1: Pulse Flow is a digital helper for owners, managers, field staff, cleaners, and stay guests. We help teams coordinate work and information. We do not rent properties, broker stays, act as a landlord or host, or provide hospitality services ourselves.
terms.summary_li2: We never collect, hold, or process rent, deposits, or other money paid for a property. Those payments stay between hosts and guests outside the app. Any paid plan we offer is only for software access (Company / Pro), never for property bookings.
terms.summary_li3: We currently operate with a focus on Thailand. A public demo is launching in Thailand (including Koh Phangan). Local rental law remains your responsibility.
terms.summary_li4: Keep your login secure. Do not misuse chat, upload harmful content, or process data you are not authorized to handle.
terms.summary_li5: We may update these Terms and suspend accounts that create risk for other users.
terms.what_title: What Pulse Flow is — and is not
terms.what_intro: Pulse Flow is software that helps all sides of property operations stay aligned: status, tasks, jobs, expense bills, contacts, team chat, guest stay coordination, house guides, master handoff notes, maintenance logs, reports, reputation tools, and optional AI agent helpers. We are a shared notebook and workflow tool — not a party to anyone’s rental or employment relationship.
terms.what_li1: We are: a software platform and helper for owners, managers, cleaning teams, field staff, vendors invited into workflows, and stay guests invited by a host.
terms.what_li2: We are not: a landlord, property manager, travel agency, booking marketplace, escrow, insurer, bank, payment processor for stays, employer of your staff, or provider of on-site rental or cleaning services.
terms.what_li3: Listing a property, inviting a guest, or recording a deposit in the app does not mean Pulse Flow is renting that property or receiving money for it.
terms.thailand_body: The Service is operated with Thailand as the primary launch market. Our public demo accounts and soft launch are aimed at users in Thailand (including Koh Phangan and nearby areas). You may create an account from elsewhere, but support and rollout priorities currently centre on Thailand. You remain solely responsible for complying with Thai law and any other law that applies to your properties, guests, and staff. Demo seats are for exploration and may be reset — do not rely on demo alone for production secrets.
terms.payments_title: No payments for properties or stays
terms.payments_body: Pulse Flow does not accept, route, hold, or refund money for rent, guest stays, security deposits, or similar property-related transfers. Hosts tell guests how to pay outside the Service. Guests may upload receipt photos and use Support commands such as /deposit so the host can confirm receipt — that is record-keeping only. Expense “bills” inside the app are operational records (for example a cleaner submitting a receipt to an owner), not card checkout for guests paying for a stay. If we charge fees, they are only for software subscriptions (Company Full or Pro / Connect your agent).
terms.features_title: Features and how we keep you safer
terms.features_body: Depending on your role and plan, the Service may include property inventory with photos and details; quick-fill from listing links or notes; stay dates and status; a bookings calendar; optional import of occupancy from third-party calendar export links (for example Airbnb, Booking.com, or VRBO iCal feeds you paste); download of service jobs as calendar files; team assignment; tasks and service jobs; contacts; team chat; guest Support chat; house guides; master info handoff files; maintenance logs; reports and exports; endorsements and talent search; push notifications; passkeys; and optional Connect your agent. Access is role-based. Guests do not see team chat or master ops files. Calendar feed URLs you paste are private secrets — treat them carefully. Pulse Flow is not affiliated with Airbnb, Booking.com, or VRBO and does not replace their listings or guest checkout. Agent connection keys never include your database password and can be revoked anytime. We use HTTPS and access controls; use strong passwords or passkeys and invite only people you trust.
terms.guest_intro: If you were invited as a stay guest, your host runs the rental. Pulse Flow only helps you request dates, receive quotes, confirm stays, view house guides and briefings, chat in Support, and track deposit status. Your host — not Pulse Flow — sets price, deposit rules, and how you pay.
terms.guest_li1: Deposits and stay money are paid directly to your host. Pulse Flow never receives that money. Send /deposit in Support with a receipt; your host confirms when received.
terms.guest_li2: Cancel at least 3 days before check-in from Stay home; within 3 days send /cancel in Support.
terms.guest_li3: Your host may cancel if a before-arrival deposit stays unpaid or unconfirmed.
terms.guest_li4: Refunds, disputes, and house rules are between you and your host. Pulse Flow does not hold guest funds or mediate payment disputes.
terms.owner_intro: You operate properties and invite teammates and stay guests. You — not Pulse Flow — are responsible for rental agreements, licensing, pricing, collecting deposits and rent, refunds, taxes, and local compliance in Thailand or wherever your property sits.
terms.owner_li1: Send clear quotes with deposit timing and off-platform payment instructions. Confirm deposits after you actually receive funds.
terms.owner_li2: Keep house guides accurate for guests. Use master info, maintenance logs, and reports for internal handoffs — treat sensitive codes as confidential.
terms.owner_li3: If you connect a third-party calendar export (Airbnb, Booking.com, VRBO, or similar), you authorize Pulse Flow to fetch that feed and show occupancy in your workspace. Keep the link private; you are responsible for source accuracy and double-booking risk if feeds are stale. Guests still book and pay on the channel — Pulse Flow does not process those bookings or channel fees.
terms.owner_li4: Guest-to-host payments happen outside Pulse Flow. Document what guests paid; guests may see deposit status under Bills.
terms.staff_intro: Field staff use the app for assigned properties, jobs, tasks, team chat, and expense bills. Pulse Flow helps coordinate that work — it is not your employer and not a party to your work contract.
terms.staff_li1: Work only on assigned properties and submit bills per your team's rules.
terms.staff_li2: Pulse Flow is not your employer; pay and supervision are with the company you work for.
terms.staff_li3: Listing yourself in staff search is optional and can be switched off at any time.
terms.staff_li4: Guest stay tools are for invited guests and are not part of the field screens.
terms.agent_intro: Owners and managers may chat with the agent in the app, or connect an external agent (for example through an MCP client such as Cursor) with a personal connection key created in Settings.
terms.agent_li1: The agent can read the team, properties, tasks, jobs and bills, create tasks and jobs, add a property, update house-guide fields, and mark a task done, only in your current workspace. It never receives the database key.
terms.agent_li2: Field staff and stay guests cannot use in-app agent chat or create a connection key.
terms.agent_li3: You are responsible for what the agent does while the key is active. Keep the key secret. Disconnect it anytime in Settings. Check its work before you rely on it.
terms.agent_li4: From the date you register, Connect your agent may be included for a free period. When billing is live, it is part of Pro: USD 19 / month on Company, or USD 9 / month on Personal — software access only, never stay payments.
terms.s5_body1: You retain ownership of Customer Content you submit (including properties, house guides, master info, maintenance logs, messages, and photos). You grant us a limited license to host and process it solely to operate, secure, and improve the Service.
terms.s5_body2: You are responsible for its legality and for complying with local privacy rules when inviting staff or storing guest and property information.

When billing is active, company owners subscribe for Company software features; managers, field staff and guests are never charged for seats. Personal workspaces stay free. Five credited referral joins unlock one year of Company (Full), counted from the day billing starts or the end of your free months, whichever comes later. These fees are never rent or deposit money.

Pulse Flow helps you coordinate; it is not legal, tax, accounting, or insurance advice, and it does not determine whether your rental activity is licensed or lawful, or guarantee payment between hosts and guests. terms.s9_body: These Terms are governed by the laws of Thailand, except where mandatory local rights apply. Courts in Thailand have non-exclusive jurisdiction. Questions: support@pulseflow.site. See also our Privacy Policy.
terms.owner_li5: Managers typically share operational access with owners, except organisation settings, full company property inventory edits, and property access assignment, as configured in the product.

privacy.meta_description: How Pulse Flow handles account and ops data as a Thailand-focused helper platform — we do not process rent or deposit payments for properties.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Pulse Flow collects, uses, and shares information when you use www.pulseflow.site, app.pulseflow.site, and related services (the "Service").
privacy.summary_li1: We collect account, operations, and technical data needed to run a safe helper platform for property teams and invited guests — not to process rent or deposit payments.
privacy.summary_li2: We use data to authenticate you, deliver features (including house guides, master info, reports, chat, and optional agents), send notifications, secure the Service, and improve the product.
privacy.summary_li3: We share data with infrastructure providers, the payment processor only when software billing is enabled, teammates according to role, and — if you connect an agent — that agent using your connection key.
privacy.summary_li4: We do not sell your personal information. We do not sell guest or property data to advertisers.
privacy.summary_li5: Primary operations and demo launch focus on Thailand; data may still be processed in regions where our providers operate.
privacy.guest_li1: We store date requests, quotes, stays, deposit status (record only), briefings, house-guide views, and Support chat (including /deposit and /cancel).
privacy.guest_li2: Receipt images in Support are stored in cloud storage so your host can confirm payment they received outside the app.
privacy.guest_li3: Your host and their authorized team can see booking and Support data for your stay. Other guests cannot.
privacy.owner_li1: We process property inventory (photos, listing links, details), optional calendar-export URLs and imported occupancy blocks, tasks, contacts, team chat, expense bills, reports, guest stays, house guides, master info, maintenance logs, billing metadata for software plans, connection keys, and agent activity for your organization.
privacy.owner_li2: Guest Support messages and deposit records are visible to authorized owners and managers.
privacy.owner_li3: Software subscription customer IDs are stored on the organization; card numbers for those subscriptions are handled by the payment processor. We never store card numbers for guest stay payments because we do not take those payments.
privacy.staff_li1: We store your profile, assigned properties, job confirmations, tasks, team chat, endorsements, and submitted bills.
privacy.staff_li2: Receipt photos for expenses are stored in cloud storage.
privacy.staff_li3: A staff search listing is optional and may be visible to owners and managers searching in the app.
privacy.staff_li4: Guest stay data stays limited to hosts and that guest.
privacy.collect_li1: Account data: name, email, role, organization, and optional profile fields.
privacy.collect_li2: Operations data: properties, tasks, jobs, contacts, bills, messages, photos, guest stays, house guides, master info, maintenance logs, reports, optional calendar-export URLs and imported occupancy blocks, and related records.
privacy.collect_li3: Technical data: device and browser type, IP address, app version, logs, and session cookies.
privacy.collect_li4: We do not collect bank-card numbers for guest rent or deposits.
privacy.use_li1: Authenticate you and enforce role-based access so guests, staff, and owners do not see each other’s private channels by default.
privacy.use_li2: Deliver features, send notifications you enable, detect abuse, and keep workspaces reliable for teams in Thailand and elsewhere.
privacy.use_li3: Improve the product with aggregated or de-identified insights.
privacy.agent_li1: If you create a connection key, we store a hash of the key, a label, scopes and usage metadata. The full key is shown once when you create it.
privacy.agent_li2: When the agent calls Pulse, we process the operational data those tools read or write — team, properties, tasks, jobs, bills, and house-guide fields — scoped to your current workspace.
privacy.agent_li3: We do not give the agent your database credentials. You can revoke the key at any time in Settings.
privacy.agent_li4: Third-party agent clients (such as your editor) process your prompts on their systems. Their privacy terms apply to that side of the conversation.
privacy.agent_li5: If you use in-app agent chat, we process your prompts, the agent's replies and the operational data those tools read or write, scoped to your current workspace.
privacy.s4_body: We retain data while your organization is active and for a reasonable period afterward for backups, disputes and legal compliance. We use encrypted transport (HTTPS), access controls, and role-separated views. You can request account deletion; some records may be retained where the law requires it. Use strong passwords or passkeys, limit invites, and protect master codes and connection keys.
privacy.s5_li1: Update profile and organization settings in the app
privacy.s5_li2: Manage or cancel Company billing and the Pro layer via the billing portal when available
privacy.s5_li3: Contact us to access, correct, or delete personal data where applicable
privacy.s5_li4: Disconnect agent connection keys in Settings
privacy.s6_body: We operate with Thailand as our primary market and demo launch region. Data may still be processed outside Thailand in regions where our providers operate. The Service is intended for business and property operations and is not directed at children under 16.
privacy.s7_body: We may update this Policy and post a revised date. Continued use means you accept the updated Policy.
privacy.s8_body: Privacy questions: support@pulseflow.site. See also our Terms of Service.
